stem: The presiding officer of the Lok Sabha, elected by its own members from among themselves, who conducts proceedings, maintains order, and casts a vote only to break a tie, is the:
explanation: The Speaker presides over the Lok Sabha and, unlike ordinary members, votes only to break a tie (casting vote) — the Rajya Sabha's presiding officer is instead the Vice-President of India, who holds the title 'Chairman of the Rajya Sabha' ex officio.

stem: Within the Council of Ministers, the senior-most rank — members who head major ministries and are part of the Cabinet, the inner decision-making body — is called a:
explanation: The Council of Ministers has three ranks: Cabinet Ministers (senior-most, sit in Cabinet meetings), Ministers of State (may hold independent charge of a ministry or assist a Cabinet Minister, but do not attend Cabinet meetings unless invited), and Deputy Ministers (assist other ministers, rarely appointed today).
